processes.name: Order window: consolidation and delivery planning

steps.text: 1. Create article and master SKU codes for the products
2. Add priced items to the webshop: visuals, specifications, taxonomy
3. Open the order window; the client is notified of dates, length and support contacts
4. Log in to the webshop through SSO (mobile or PC)
5. Browse items; view MOQs and price breaks
6. Select items and submit the order; buying team is notified automatically
7. Receive the sales order form; the order joins all other incoming orders
8. Close the order window on the agreed date; client is notified by email
9. Consolidate orders automatically, including DC and freight cost, quantities per market and material cost
10. Is the consolidated quote acceptable?
11. Confirm the quote through the tool; buying team is notified
12. Re-quote automatically; the system can ask the supplier for updated numbers
13. Prepare the final sales order split per market and push it to the client
14. Review and confirm the final sales order split per market

16. Receive and validate the client PO against the initial sales order form
17. Raise supplier PO and send it automatically; supplier is notified
18. Receive supplier PO; confirm receipt, validate specs, schedule resource, confirm in the tool
19. Launch production; notify the buying team
20. Warehousing hub receives goods into inventory
21. Warehouse updates stock automatically; buying team is notified of receipt and stock levels
22. Pick and pack goods per market order with integrated software
23. Ship to the markets automatically; updates go to a/i by software
24. Issue proof of delivery on delivery, for example by code scan; buying team is notified
